name: hcapp_updatePhotoStatus
description: Actions one kennel photo, of any current status (initial review or re-review). Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 33). Gate: HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'editPhoto' on the photo's own kennel (Hash Flash / GM / VGM / RA and whoever the data-driven matrix grants), OR the photo's own uploader when setting it Private (action 2) — their photo, their call, at any point (James, 2026-09-13). Action 1 soft-deletes (DeletedAt; Status unchanged). Actions 2-6 clear DeletedAt and set the single-rung Status (0 Private, 2 Members, 3 Public, 4 Featured, 5 Cover). Going Private or deleted clears HC.Event.EventCoverPhotoUrl if this photo was the cover; action 6 demotes any previous cover to Public (3) and writes COALESCE(EditedBlobUrl, BlobUrl) as the run's cover. Used by the app's photo viewer ('Make private', map_photo_page.dart) — the header comment saying it is unused is wrong; review screens use hcapp_batchUpdatePhotoStatus. Called by the app's photo viewer for 'Make private' (action 2); the app never sends action 7 (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: photoId
parameters.description: UUID of the photo to action. If no KennelPhotos row matches, a 'Photo not found' error is returned (errorCode 1333, errorType 13).

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: 1 soft-delete (DeletedAt set, Status unchanged); 2 Private (Status 0); 3 Members (2); 4 Public (3); 5 Featured (4); 6 run cover (5); 7 accepted but retired — falls to the CASE ELSE and sets Status 0 (Private). 2-7 clear DeletedAt. Anything else → 1233 / errorType 12.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always present. Failure: success = 0 with ValidateAppAuth codes, 1233 / 12 invalid action, 1333 / 13 photo not found, 1333 / 13 not authorised, 1933 / 19 unhandled. Success: success = 1, errorCode / errorType NULL.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code. NULL on success.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification code. NULL on success.

rowsets.name: ActionResult
rowsets.description: On success: the photo id, the status rung it was set to, and DeletedAt for action 1.

columns.name: newStatus
columns.description: The rung for actions 2-7; 0 for action 1 (Status is NOT changed on a soft delete — see codeSmells).

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: On failure, in place of ActionResult.

sideEffects: Action 1: UPDATE HC.KennelPhotos SET DeletedAt, UpdatedAt; clear HC.Event.EventCoverPhotoUrl when it equals this photo's BlobUrl or EditedBlobUrl.
Actions 2-7: UPDATE HC.KennelPhotos SET Status, DeletedAt = NULL, UpdatedAt. When the new Status is 0 (Private), clear the run's EventCoverPhotoUrl if it was this photo.
Action 6: UPDATE other HC.KennelPhotos of the run with Status 5 to Status 3; UPDATE HC.Event SET EventCoverPhotoUrl = COALESCE(EditedBlobUrl, BlobUrl).
All writes in one transaction. HC.Event updates fire its updatedAt trigger, so the run re-syncs to phones.
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on invalid action, not found, refusal, or unhandled error (CATCH rolls back first).

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken, @photoId, @action (lines 3-6) have no SQL default. A client that omits one is refused by SQL before the procedure runs: no HC.ErrorLog row, an empty 500 in the app, and any graceful check inside is unreachable (CLAUDE.md, Rack of Lamb 2026-09-29).

The CASE expression that computes @newStatus defaults WHEN 1 THEN 0, so when action=1 (soft-delete), the returned newStatus is 0 (private) even though the photo is soft-deleted (DeletedAt is set). A caller reading newStatus=0 cannot distinguish a soft-deleted photo from a truly private one — they must inspect deletedAt.
Line 6 @action TINYINT and line 160 @newStatus TINYINT. KennelPhotos.Status is TINYINT, but the project standard is SMALLINT for new parameters.

codeSmells.issue: One error code for two different failures, non-standard types
codeSmells.detail: Lines 115 and 144 both return 1333 / 13 (not found vs not authorised). Line 86 uses errorType 12 and line 238 errorType 19 rather than 2 and 5.

codeSmells.issue: Retired action 7 still accepted and silently makes the photo Private
codeSmells.detail: Line 84 accepts 7, and the CASE at lines 160-167 has no WHEN 7, so it falls to ELSE 0: an old client 'unfeaturing' a photo gets it set Private, DeletedAt cleared and possibly the run cover removed. Either refuse 7 or map it explicitly. Not reachable from the app (it never sends action 7; checked 2026-10-13).

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 predecessor. No breaking changes from migration.
